original_claim: Fully sealed to HEPA H13 standard
test_context: MPPS efficiency tested at IBR US per ASTM F3150, EN1822, DEHS-oil particles; compared to 'other air purifiers market data from March 2020'.
limitation: Comparison baseline is other purifiers' March-2020 market data, not current competitors; lab-chamber seal test, not real-room performance.

original_claim: POLAR whole-room test: 81 cubic-metre room with 9 sensors vs industry-standard 28.5 cubic-metre room with 1 sensor
test_context: Dyson's own proprietary POLAR protocol, not a named external/industry standard.
limitation: Self-designed, self-administered test; not verifiable against an independent standards body or public database.

limitation: Sealed-chamber CADR-plateau lab test; pollutant reduction does not equal real-room exposure reduction, biomarker change, symptom improvement, or clinical outcome.

limitation: Tests influenza A/H1N1 specifically, not COVID-19; sealed lab test at max fan speed (atypical real-world setting); does not establish reduced infection/illness risk for users.
